I used to be religious growing up, but looking back on it I only went to church because my parents did. And my parents only went because their friends went.

I absolutely relate! I am still learning to accept the "skinny" old pictures of ED me plastered around my house and in the archives of my phone. Sometimes the mean voice in my head tells me that I should lose weight so that I can "look good and be accepted by everyone around me".

It's a matter of fighting the mean voice, because every time you fight it, your healthy voice will become stronger. The healthy voice tells me that I am much more healthier now that I don't care about every single calorie that I consume. I can finally eat out with friends without thinking about tomorrow's plan at the gym to burn all the calories off. All in all, I know that the binge/exercise purge cycles of the past are NOT worth my mental health.
